Meg’s gift is her ability to build rapport with children, see their inner intelligence, and awaken their natural desire to learn. 53.review_description:

She has also developed a great relationship with our family, and we work together to support my daughter’s continued growth. My daughter will be entering 8th grade next year, and Michaela has done an amazing job preparing her for what’s ahead.

We honestly don't know what we would do without her.  I highly recommend Michaela to any family looking for an outstanding tutor.

79.review_title: Exceptional Structure, Clarity, and Extraordinary Progress
79.review_description: She is without question the best I have ever worked with. 79.review_title: Clear, Practical Teaching with Real Results
79.review_description: At the start of my violin journey I worked with several teachers, but Adriana is by far the best I have ever worked with. Her teaching method is clear, practical, and full of small shortcuts that make a real difference to progress. She pays close attention to detail while never losing sight of the music as a whole. She is also one of the kindest and most encouraging teachers I have had, which made lessons both motivating and enjoyable.

Mia figlia Manuela suona il violino con Adriana da un paio di anni e si trova molto bene. Ha fatto progressi davvero rapidi! Adriana ha infatti trovato un metodo divertente e coinvolgente per catturare l'attenzione della mia bimba e insegnare la tecnica in modo efficace. Le lezioni sono sempre stimolanti e ogni settimana Manuela torna a casa con pezzi ed esercizi nuovi da studiare. La raccomando sicuramente a chi cerca un'insegnante preparata e capace di trasmettere la passione per la musica ai bambini.

Adriana est une excellente professeur. Elle s'efforce constamment de marier exigence et bienveillance. Avec elle, Lucien fait de constants progrès, acquiert la confiance dans son jeu et prend plaisir à pratiquer son instrument et à jouer en concert.

Adriana ha sido profesora de violín de nuestra hija Ada durante los últimos años y ha desempeñado un papel muy importante en su desarrollo musical. Durante este tiempo, hemos visto un progreso constante tanto en su técnica como en su musicalidad, y Ada ha ganado confianza en su práctica diaria y en sus presentaciones.

Lo que distingue a Adriana es su compromiso con la enseñanza. Es una profesora dedicada, con un alto nivel de rigor, y se toma muy en serio que cada clase cumpla sus objetivos.

Además de su sólida preparación como violinista y docente, Adriana tiene una gran capacidad para motivar a los niños. Enseña desde el respeto, la paciencia y el refuerzo positivo, ayudándolos a sentirse orgullosos de sus avances y motivados para seguir aprendiendo.

La recomendamos con total confianza a cualquier familia que busque una profesora de violín comprometida y apasionada por la enseñanza.

79.review_title: Building Confidence and Musical Joy from the First Lessons
79.review_description:
What a great pleasure it was to have Adriana teach our son Tristan. She was always encouraging and supportive of him; from games in musical kindergarten, to picking up his first violin, to performing in front of a church hall. Adriana’s lessons are always fund and engaging, and at the right pace, and in the end it brought out the best of Tristan as a student and performer. We wish her every success as she deserves it all. 

Additionally, Tristan had started his violin journey again abroad. He is doing very well. Thanks for starting his violin journey.

Liam has thoroughly enjoyed his viola lessons with Adriana. Since starting lessons, he has made excellent technical progress and has developed a much stronger understanding of rhythm, pitch, and musical expression. We have been particularly impressed by the range of repertoire he has learned and his growing ability to play with confidence and musicality.

Her patient, encouraging, and engaging teaching style has helped Liam build both his skills and his confidence. He is always excited to share what he has learned and approaches practice with a positive attitude. We have also noticed a significant improvement in his confidence when performing in front of others.

Most importantly, Liam genuinely enjoys learning with Adriana. Her enthusiasm and support have fostered a love of music and helped him develop as a young musician.

I am thankful for her dedication and encouragement throughout his musical journey.

Adriana has been teaching our daughter since the very beginning and we are so pleased with progress so far. From a technical point of view, there is great bow control, sound production and intonation is always accurate. Adriana makes things fun too! But she also has a (much needed) authority, to keep a chatty 5 year old focussed. Adriana is very kind and supportive. Our daughter has progressed into repertoire she now recognises and sings for herself, showing that she is now fully engaged in the journey. Also she has had remarkably few concerns about performing - something that Adriana conveys and supports as a very natural part of the process.

We would unhesitatingly commend Adriana as a superb and supportive teacher.

79.review_title: Clear Weekly Aims and Steady Progress
79.review_description: Adriana has been teaching my 6 year old daughter the violin for a few months now. In that time Adriana has laid out clear weekly aims for my daughter to achieve. This has made practice much easier as my daughter is aware of exactly what to practice in terms of technical exercises and she has been able to move on to varied/different repertoire each week. My daughter feels very happy to attend her lessons with Adriana and I feel she is progressing at a good pace thanks to Adriana.

Adriana  is an inspiring and experienced teacher who combines a strong focus on technique with engaging, purposeful lessons. Each session is carefully structured and focused, helping my daughter make clear technical progress while developing greater musicality and a broader, more interesting repertoire. Her guidance has strengthened my daughter's confidence both in practice and in performance, and she knows exactly how to challenge her without making the process feel overwhelming. Most importantly, Adriana inspires enthusiasm and a genuine desire for my child to learn the violin. Her experience, insight and encouragement have made a real difference to my daughter's  playing and to the enjoyment she gains from music.

It has been a wonderful experience watching Scarlette grow as a young violinist under Adriana’s guidance. From the very beginning, Adriana has created an encouraging, and supportive environment that has helped Scarlette develop not only her musical skills but also her confidence and love of learning.

Over time, we have seen remarkable progress in Scarlette's technical ability. Her posture, bow control, intonation, and overall musicianship have improved significantly.

Working with Adriana has been a genuine pleasure. She is patient, kind, dedicated, and deeply invested in her students' progress. Her positive encouragement and belief in Scarlette have made a lasting impact, and we are truly grateful for the care and expertise she brings to every lesson.

I wholeheartedly recommend her to any parent looking for a violin teacher who not only develops strong musical foundations but also nurtures a lifelong skills determination for kids, including self-motivation and determination.

My daughter has greatly enjoyed learning violin with Adriana. We’ve seen clear technical progress in her playing, as well as a growing confidence in both her practice and performances. Lessons are always encouraging, engaging and tailored to her needs, helping her stay motivated and develop a genuine love of music. We are very grateful for the positive impact Adriana has had on her musical journey.

Florence has made excellent progress in her violin playing since studying with Adriana. Her technical skills have developed steadily, and she has gained confidence in tackling more challenging pieces and expanding her repertoire. 

We have particularly noticed her growing independence in practice and her increased confidence when performing. Beyond the musical progress, Florence genuinely enjoys her lessons and always looks forward to working with Adriana. 

Her patient, encouraging, and structured approach creates a positive learning environment while maintaining high standards. We appreciate the way she balances technical development with musical expression, helping Florence grow both as a violinist and as a young musician.

We are thankful to Adriana for her dedication and support.

My daughter has been taking viola lessons with Adriana for 3 years now, and her progress has been tremendous.

Adriana is a professional, skilled and caring teacher and violinist who really brought out the best in her pupils. She gently guides her pupils with care, helping them grow not only in music, but also in confidence. Her warm personality and dedication make every lesson feel inspiring and welcoming.

Adriana has a meticulous approach to posture, bowing, and intonation, and tailors lessons to my daughter’s pace and ensures concepts are fully understood before moving on. Adriana also carefully chose pieces that challenge my daughter while keeping her engaged and excited when playing. My daughter has enjoyed every pieces that she has played and her progress in playing pieces is incredible.

I highly recommend Adriana to any parent looking for a teacher who cares deeply about both technical excellence and the sheer joy of playing music.

Adriana is a great teacher who can balance fun and engagement and rigour around her lessons. 

She is always honest and helpful, Lia likes her very much. 

She always explains what needs improving and praise well when Lia does great. 

We are super happy with Adriana and can not wait to continue working with her.

We have been very impressed with the progress Alisa has made in a relatively short period of time. Through Adriana’s teaching, she has developed a solid technical foundation and has gained confidence in both her practice routine and performance skills. Adriana’s clear explanations, structured approach, and encouragement have helped her become more independent and motivated in her learning.

From the very beginning, Alisa very much enjoyed the lessons with Adriana because of her warm, encouraging and child-friendly teaching style. Her sense of humour and ability to make lessons engaging and enjoyable create a positive learning environment that motivates young students and helps them feel relaxed and confident.

We greatly appreciate her dedication, professionalism, and ability to inspire young musicians, and we are very grateful for the positive impact Adriana has had on Alisa's musical journey.

Our son started Violin lessons in September 2025. Adriana assumed the role of his violin teacher following the sudden departure of his previous teacher in February 2026. Since taking the reins, Adriana has utilised her kind and encouraging manner to instil and develop a sense of confidence and perseverance in Ari's (and our!) approach to practicing and performance preparation. With her thorough yet pragmatic notes, she has helped us understand important aspects of technique that are important for laying the foundations for progress. She has also helped us navigate repertoire development and choice with a genuinely collaborative manner. Her excellent organisation and communication has also allowed us to navigate scheduling of sessions and performances with ease. Although the violin has presented a fairly steep initial learning curve (especially for a 5 year old!), we have been so heartened to see Ari progress every week in terms of ability and also appreciation.

Adriana has helped my 6 year old daughter built great fundamental skills at the start. She has been so wonderful articulating in ways that little children can understand and relate. Her lessons are also very structured so children can focus on the important messages. We couldn’t be happier with the progress and having her as a teacher.

79.review_title: Patience, clarté et enseignement réellement bienveillant
